input.name: Login with Sample Login and Open Cars Gadget
input.description: Logs into Zaz UI using a sample admin login, opens the gadgets menu, opens the Cars gadget, and verifies it renders a table of car data.

outputs.name: cars_grid_text
outputs.description: Text content of the Cars gadget data grid confirming tabular car data is displayed

steps.intent: Start at entry route which redirects to an error/interstitial page prompting login
Follow the LOGIN link to reach the sample logins list
Select the sample Admin user (id 100) to log in
Open the gadgets toolbar entry that opens/reveals the Cars gadget

locator.description: Cars gadget launcher button in toolbar

steps.intent: Verify the Cars gadget grid displays tabular data rows and extract the grid content

business_outcomes.message: The Cars gadget opened but returned no rows of data.
